tools.name: change_wall_thickness
tools.description: Change the thickness (mm) of a wall identified by its ID (e.g. W1). The wall is a pair of parallel planar faces in the FeatureGraph; only face_a is offset to avoid topology breakage.

tools.name: change_hole_diameter
tools.description: Change the diameter (mm) of an existing hole identified by its ID (e.g. H1).

tools.name: change_fillet_radius
tools.description: Change the radius (mm) of a fillet chain (e.g. FC1). All fillet faces in the chain are offset; sign is auto-handled per face concavity.

tools.name: change_boss_diameter
tools.description: Change the outer diameter (mm) of a boss identified by its ID (e.g. B1).

tools.name: change_boss_height
tools.description: Change the height (mm) of a boss along its axis by offsetting the boss top planar face.

tools.name: add_boss
tools.description: Add a cylindrical boss on top of the body at the given position. Boss extrudes upward (+Z) by height.

position_mm.description: Boss base center (X, Y, Z) in mm

tools.name: add_hole
tools.description: Drill a hole (cylindrical Subtract) into the body. If through=true, cutter spans the body's Z extent; else depth_mm must be > 0 (blind hole).

position_mm.description: Hole entrance center (X, Y, Z) in mm

depth_mm.description: Blind hole depth in mm (required when through=false)

tools.name: add_slit
tools.description: Add a rectangular slit (slot) on the body's top face. Length axis defaults to +Y; width is perpendicular in-plane. Cutter excavates downward by depth.

position_mm.description: Slit center on top face (X, Y, Z) in mm

orientation_axis.description: Direction of the slit long axis (optional, default +Y)

tools.name: add_pocket
tools.description: Add an axis-aligned rectangular pocket (Subtract) on the body's top face. width=X span, length=Y span, depth=Z depth.

position_mm.description: Pocket center on top face (X, Y, Z) in mm

tools.name: add_rib
tools.description: Add a rectangular rib (Unite) on the top face running from start to end along the XY-projected centerline. Width = perpendicular thickness, height = +Z extrusion.

start_position_mm.description: Rib centerline start (X, Y, Z) in mm

end_position_mm.description: Rib centerline end (X, Y, Z) in mm

height_mm.description: Rib height in mm above top face (> 0)

tools.name: add_chamfer
tools.description: Apply a small fillet (chamfer approximation) to body edges matching the given filter ('all' | 'top' | 'bottom' | 'vertical').

tools.name: add_hole_pattern
tools.description: Add multiple holes at once. pattern_type: 'Linear' | 'Circular' | 'Grid'. For Linear/Circular set count and spacing; for Grid set rows, cols, row_spacing, col_spacing.

center_mm.description: Pattern center (X, Y, Z) in mm

axis_direction.description: Linear: in-plane direction; Circular: circle plane normal

count.description: Hole count for Linear/Circular (>= 2 for Circular)

spacing.description: Linear: spacing in mm; Circular: ring radius in mm

row_spacing.description: Grid row spacing in mm (Grid only)

col_spacing.description: Grid column spacing in mm (Grid only)

depth_mm.description: Blind hole depth in mm (when through=false)

tools.name: remove_hole
tools.description: Fill an existing hole (Unite a matching cylinder). Works for through or blind holes.

tools.name: move_hole
tools.description: Move an existing hole by filling the old location and re-drilling at new_position_mm with the same D, depth, and through-ness.

new_position_mm.description: New entrance center (X, Y, Z) in mm

tools.name: move_boss
tools.description: Move an existing boss: subtract the old boss volume, then add a same-D/H boss at new_position_mm.

new_position_mm.description: New base center (X, Y, Z) in mm

tools.name: rotate_boss
tools.description: Rotate an existing boss about (axis_point_mm, axis_direction) by angle_deg. The boss is removed and re-added at the rotated base position.

tools.name: rotate_hole
tools.description: Rotate an existing hole about (axis_point_mm, axis_direction) by angle_deg. The old hole is filled and a same-D hole is drilled at the rotated position.

tools.name: mirror_feature
tools.description: Mirror a hole ('H*') or boss ('B*') across a plane (normal, origin). The original is kept; a same-dimension copy is added at the reflected position.

mirror_plane_origin.description: A point on the mirror plane (mm)

tools.name: get_feature_graph
tools.description: Return the FeatureGraph of the current body as JSON. Use this to discover available IDs (H*, B*, W*, FC*) before issuing modification tools.

tools.name: find_features_by_type
tools.description: Return the IDs of features of a given type ('hole'|'boss'|'wall'|'fillet_chain'|'slit'). Optional min_value / max_value filter on the primary dimension (D for hole/boss, R for fillet_chain, thickness for wall).

min_value.description: Inclusive lower bound on primary dimension (mm)

max_value.description: Inclusive upper bound on primary dimension (mm)

tools.name: generate_phone
tools.description: Generate a phone front-metal part FROM SCRATCH (no imported CAD needed) into a fresh document. Builds a uniform-wall hollow shell from the given envelope. All dimensions in mm; unspecified fields use sensible defaults.

camera_bump_mm.description: Camera plateau height above the back; omit for none

tools.name: set_camera_height
tools.description: Change the camera bump height of the generated phone and regenerate. Edits the parametric source of truth so the body stays consistent with the design parameters.
